title: On the Structure of Higher Zhu Induced Modules in Positive Characteristic
summary: Let $F$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from $2$, and let $V$ be a nonnegatively integer-graded vertex operator algebra over $F$. We consider higher Zhu algebras obtained by taking a quotient of $V$ by a relation space containing the vectors $D_V^{(h)}a-\binom{-\mathrm{wt}(a)}{h}a$ for all homogeneous $a\in V$ and integers $h\geq1$, where $D_V^{(h)}a=a_{-h-1}\mathbf1$. For $n\geq1$ and a nonzero unital module $U$ over the corresponding higher Zhu algebra, we study the quotients $L_n(U)$ of induced modules and determine the kernel of the canonical map…
